text:
deploy-bot: Deployment finished: runtime-prod v2.3.1 -> 100% traffic. Canary to 10% started.

sara: seeing tail latency spike on canary slice. 95p ~800ms -> p99 > 2s. dashboards.redwood/graphs/xyz

jordan: noticed kernel-swap events in the canary hosts, lots of 'hw_kernel_swap' and 'fallback_to_generic' in logs :warning:

jordan: logs snippet:
```
[2025-10-12T10:15:02Z] host-7 runtime: kernel_swap: selected generic_kernel for model-ggml
[2025-10-12T10:15:03Z] host-7 runtime: fallback_to_cpu: kv-cache miss handling
[2025-10-12T10:15:05Z] host-9 runtime: batch_window increased to 150ms
```

mike: is there a quick FF to stop the rollout? /ff runtime.use_new_kernel false

sara: flipping ff now -> /ff runtime.use_new_kernel off :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Feature flag runtime.use_new_kernel set to OFF by sara. Routing rollback to stable pools initiated.

ana-cs: FYI CS got 3 customers reporting spike and a couple 502s, list in DM. escalating.

jordan: looks like the new kernel disabled the micro-batching path, which blew up queue lengths. we'll need to revert kernel AND re-enable batching defaults.

sara: starting partial rollback of canary to v2.2.8 and requeueing events. command: `redwoodctl rollout revert --target stable --max-surge 0`

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by sara. Traffic shifting back to v2.2.8. Expected convergence ~3m.

ops-sre: scaling canary workers up x2 to drain backlog and reduce latency while rollback completes.

mike: monitor p95/p99 and error rate. if p99 stays >1s after rollback -> re-run canary with kernel patch. alert me directly.

sara: p95 back to ~140ms, p99 trending down. error rate dropping. keeping kill flag off until we validate patch.

jordan: preparing a small patch to restore batching fastpath in the new kernel; will run tests in staging then canary tomorrow.

ana-cs: informing affected customers, asking if any follow-ups needed.

mike: handing oncall to jordan for 30m follow-up, i'm available if things re-escalate. :handshake:

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged: runtime.canary.latency. Severity: sev2. Status: mitigated (rollback & FF cutover). Customers contacted. Incident closed for now; reopen if metrics worsen.
